children: UK online music retailer's H1 revenue rose 6% yr/yr, driven by UK and international growth
Gross profit and EBITDA increased, while gross margin slipped to 27.6% from 28.0%
Company says lower EBITDA reflects setup costs for new automated UK warehouse
Gear4music expects FY27 results to be in line with consensus market expectations
Consensus for FY27 is revenue of £200.2 mln, EBITDA of £16.0 mln, PBT of £6.0 mln
Company says it is well prepared for the upcoming peak trading period
INTERNATIONAL GROWTH - Co said European and Rest of World revenues rose 11% yr/yr, supporting overall revenue increase
SETUP COSTS - Co said lower EBITDA reflects previously reported setup costs for new automated UK warehouse
DISCRETIONARY SPENDING ENVIRONMENT - Co said performance reflects strength of customer proposition in challenging environment for discretionary consumer spending
Oct 18 - UK housing market showing signs of mortgage rates impact, Rightmove says
